units.Nahum 1:1: An oracle concerning Nineveh; the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
units.Nahum 1:2: The Lord is a jealous and avenging God, the Lord avenging with fury, the Lord avenging Himself on His adversaries, and He Himself removes His enemies.
units.Nahum 1:3: The Lord is patient, and His strength is great; the Lord certainly will not acquit. His way is in consummation and shaking; clouds are the dust of His feet.
units.Nahum 1:4: He threatens the sea and dries it up, and makes all the rivers desolate. Bashan and Carmel have dwindled, and Lebanon’s flowering things have failed.
units.Nahum 1:5: Mountains shook before Him and hills were shaken; the whole earth recoiled before Him, and all who dwell in it.
units.Nahum 1:6: Who will stand before His anger? Who will resist His furious wrath? His fury melts rulers, and rocks were crushed before Him.
units.Nahum 1:7: The Lord is good to those who wait for Him in a day of affliction, and He knows those who revere Him.
units.Nahum 1:8: With an advancing flood He will make a complete end of those who rise up, and darkness will pursue His enemies.
units.Nahum 1:9: What do you devise against the Lord? He will make a complete end; He will not exact vengeance twice upon the same thing in affliction.
units.Nahum 1:10: For it will be laid waste to their foundation, consumed like an entwining thorn-vine and like stubble full of dryness.
units.Nahum 1:11: From you will come a scheme, devising evil things in opposition to the Lord.
units.Nahum 1:12: Thus says the Lord who rules many waters: Even so they will be separated, and your report will no longer be heard.
units.Nahum 1:13: And now I will crush his rod away from you and tear apart your bonds.
units.Nahum 1:14: The Lord will command concerning you: No more will be sown from your name. From the house of your god I will destroy carved and cast images. I will make your burial, for they are swift.
units.Nahum 2:1: Look, upon the mountains are the feet of one bringing good news and announcing peace! Celebrate your feasts, Judah; repay your vows. For they will no longer pass through you into decay. It has been completed; it has been removed.
units.Nahum 2:2: One who breathes into your face has come up, rescuing from affliction. Watch the road; hold your waist firm; act courageously with great strength,
units.Nahum 2:3: because the Lord turned away Jacob’s arrogance, as Israel’s arrogance; for those shaking them out shook out both them and their vine branches; they ruined
units.Nahum 2:4: the weapons of their might from among people, mighty men playing in fire. The reins of their chariots are on the day of his preparation, and the horsemen will be thrown into uproar
units.Nahum 2:5: in the roads, and the chariots will be thrown into confusion and entangled in the squares; their appearance is like torches of fire and lightning flashing past.
units.Nahum 2:6: Their nobles will remember and flee by day; they will weaken on their journey, hurry to the walls and prepare their defenses.
units.Nahum 2:7: The river gates were opened, and the royal palace collapsed.
units.Nahum 2:8: The foundation was uncovered, and she was going up, and her slave women were being led away like doves murmuring in their hearts.
units.Nahum 2:9: Nineveh—her waters are like a swimming pool; they were fleeing and did not stop, and there was no one looking back.
units.Nahum 2:10: They were plundering silver; they were plundering gold. There was no limit to her adornment; they have been weighed down beyond all her desirable vessels.
units.Nahum 2:11: Shaking out, tossing up and boiling over; broken hearts, loosening knees, pangs at every waist, and every face like the scorching of a pot.
units.Nahum 2:12: Where is the lions’ dwelling and the pasture that belonged to the cubs, where a lion went to enter there, a lion’s cub, and no one frightened them?
units.Nahum 2:13: A lion seized enough for his cubs and strangled for his lions; he filled his nest with prey and his dwelling with plunder.
units.Nahum 2:14: Look, I am against you, says the Lord Almighty. I will burn your multitude in smoke; the sword will consume your lions. I will destroy your prey from the earth, and your deeds will never again be heard.
units.Nahum 3:1: O city of bloodshed, wholly false, full of injustice! Prey will not be touched.
units.Nahum 3:2: The sound of whips and the sound of shaking wheels, of a pursuing horse and a jolting chariot,
units.Nahum 3:3: and of a mounting horseman, a flashing sword and glittering weapons, a multitude of slain and a grievous fall! There was no limit to her nations, and they will weaken in their bodies
units.Nahum 3:4: because of the multitude of prostitution. A prostitute, beautiful and pleasing, mistress of potions, selling nations through her prostitution and tribes through her potions,
units.Nahum 3:5: look, I am against you, says the Lord God Almighty. I will expose your hind parts over your face and show nations your shame and kingdoms your dishonor,
units.Nahum 3:6: and cast abomination upon you according to your impurities, and make you an example,
units.Nahum 3:7: and everyone seeing you will spring away and say, “Miserable Nineveh! Who will lament her? Where shall I seek consolation for her?”
units.Nahum 3:8: Prepare a portion; tune a string; prepare a portion, Amon, who dwells among rivers, water around her, whose dominion was the sea and whose walls were water,
units.Nahum 3:9: and Ethiopia was her strength, and Egypt, and there is no limit to the flight; Libyans became her helpers.
units.Nahum 3:10: She too will go into deportation as a captive; they will dash her infants to the ground at the head of all her roads, cast lots for all her glorious things; and all her nobles will be bound in handcuffs.
units.Nahum 3:11: You too will become drunk and be overlooked; you too will seek a place to stand away from enemies.
units.Nahum 3:12: All your fortresses are fig trees having lookouts; if shaken, they will fall into the eater’s mouth.
units.Nahum 3:13: Look, your people within you are like women! The gates of your land will open wide to your enemies, and fire will consume your bars.
units.Nahum 3:14: Draw water for yourself for the siege, hold your fortresses firmly; step into mud, be trampled in straw, hold fast over the brick.
units.Nahum 3:15: There fire will consume you; a sword will destroy you, devouring you like a locust, and you will become heavy like a crawling locust.
units.Nahum 3:16: You multiplied your trading beyond the stars of heaven. A crawling locust rushed out and flew away.
units.Nahum 3:17: Your mixed company leaped away like a young locust, like a locust perched on a fence on frosty days. The sun rose, it leaped away, and it did not know its place. Woe to them!
units.Nahum 3:18: Your shepherds slumbered; the Assyrian king put your rulers to sleep. Your people departed upon the mountains, and there was no one receiving them.
units.Nahum 3:19: There is no healing for your crushing; your wound has become inflamed. All who hear the report of you will clap their hands over you, for upon whom has your evil not continually come?
units.Jonah 1:1: The word of the Lord came to Jonah, the son of Amittai, saying:
units.Jonah 1:2: “Rise and go to Nineveh, the great city, and proclaim in it, for the outcry of its wickedness has come up to Me.”
units.Jonah 1:3: But Jonah rose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord. He went down to Joppa, found a ship traveling to Tarshish, paid its fare and boarded it, to sail with them to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.

units.Isaiah 50:3: I will clothe heaven in darkness and make its covering like sackcloth.”

units.Isaiah 47:7: You said, ‘I will rule for ever.’ You did not consider these things in your heart or remember the last things.
units.Isaiah 47:8: Now hear these things, pampered one who sits confident, saying in her heart, ‘I am, and there is no other. I will not sit as a widow or know bereavement.’
units.Isaiah 47:9: Now these two will come upon you suddenly, in one day: widowhood and childlessness will come suddenly upon you, amid your sorcery and the overwhelming power of your enchanters,
units.Isaiah 47:10: in your hope of wickedness. For you said, ‘I am, and there is no other.’ Know that understanding these things and your prostitution will become your shame. You said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no other.’
units.Isaiah 47:11: Destruction will come upon you, and you will certainly not know it—a pit, and you will fall into it. Misery will come upon you, and you will certainly not be able to become clean. Destruction will come upon you suddenly, and you will certainly not know it.
units.Isaiah 47:12: Stand now amid your enchantments and your abundant sorcery, which you learned from youth, if you can be helped.
units.Isaiah 47:13: You have toiled in your counsels. Let heaven’s astrologers stand up and save you; let those watching the stars announce to you what is about to come upon you.
units.Isaiah 28:1: Woe to the crown of insolence, Ephraim’s hired men; the flower fallen from glory on the summit of the fertile mountain, those drunk without wine!
units.Isaiah 28:2: Behold, the Lord’s wrath is strong and harsh, like falling hail with no covering, falling violently. Like a great mass of water dragging a country, He will give the land rest with His hands.
units.Isaiah 28:3: Underfoot will be trampled the crown of insolence, Ephraim’s hired men.
units.Isaiah 28:4: The flower fallen from the hope of glory, on the high mountain’s summit, will be like an early fig: whoever sees it will want to swallow it before taking it into his hand.
units.Ezekiel 30:3: For the Lord’s day is near; it will be a day, an end of nations.
units.Ezekiel 30:4: A sword will come upon the Egyptians, and there will be turmoil in Ethiopia; wounded men will fall in Egypt, and her foundations will collapse together.
units.Ezekiel 30:5: Persians, Cretans, Lydians, Libyans, all the mixed company, and some of the sons of My covenant will fall by the sword in her.
units.Ezekiel 30:6: Egypt’s supports will fall, and the arrogance of her strength will come down from Migdol to Syene; they will fall in her by the sword, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 30:13: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: I will destroy the magnates from Memphis and the rulers from the land of Egypt, and they will be no more.
units.Ezekiel 30:14: I will destroy the land of Pathros, put fire upon Tanis, and execute vengeance in Diospolis,
units.Ezekiel 30:15: and pour out My wrath upon Sais, Egypt’s strength, and destroy the multitude of Memphis.
units.Ezekiel 30:16: I will put fire upon Egypt; Syene will be greatly troubled, and in Diospolis there will be a breach, and waters will pour out.
units.Isaiah 34:1: Draw near, nations, and hear, rulers! Let the earth and those in it hear, the inhabited world and the people in it!
units.Isaiah 34:2: For the Lord’s wrath is against all nations, and anger against their number, to destroy them and hand them over to slaughter.
units.Isaiah 34:3: Their wounded and dead will be thrown out; their odor will rise, and mountains will be soaked with their blood.
units.Isaiah 34:4: Heaven will roll up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall like leaves from a vine, like leaves falling from a fig tree.
units.Ezekiel 26:1: In the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 26:2: “Son of man, because Tyre said of Jerusalem, ‘Well done! She is shattered; the nations have perished. She has turned to me; the full one has been laid waste,’
units.Ezekiel 26:3: therefore thus says the Lord: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea rises with its waves.
units.Ezekiel 26:4: They will throw down Tyre’s walls and throw down your towers. I will winnow her dust from her and make her a smooth rock.
units.Ezekiel 26:5: She will be a drying place for nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord. She will become plunder for the nations,
